Lena: Heads-up 0k benchmark webinar next Thurs. Need social sprint: X thread (3 posts), LinkedIn long post + stat image, 15s clip for stories. Can someone own creative + routing? @Omar?

Omar: I can do creative. Need 3 topline bullet stats and the raw footage.

Tess: Stats are ready in the one-pager: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/apr_onepager.pdf. Highlights: 62% latency reduction, 2.1x throughput, 35% cost saved with batching.

Omar: Perfect. Will make stat image + square clip. ETA Wed noon.

Lena: Routing: tag leads `bench-apr-webinar` and route to SDR rotation `webinar-inbound`. UTM: utm_campaign=bench_apr&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic. Can @Kai set the rule?

Kai: On it. Will create rule and run test in staging. Also add utm_content to differentiate `x_thread` vs `li_post`.

Tracking-bot: Reminder: Best post windows show Tue/Wed 11:00 PT and Thu 09:00 PT.

Tess: Copy approach: X thread opens with bold stat, follow-up post dives into method, final post CTA to register. LinkedIn long post will include PM quote. I'll draft captions and post variations A/B by Tue EOD.

Omar: For X, keep captions under 180 chars. I'll supply image alt text for accessibility.

Kai: Staging test passing at 15:18 PT 0 samples routed correctly. Will run prod smoke after publish.

Lena: Scheduling plan: Tue 11:00 PT 0 X lead stat + clip; Wed 11:00 PT 0 LinkedIn long post + stat image; Thu 09:00 PT 0 X final thread + register CTA. If first 24h CTR < 0.9% we swap to "Watch on demand" and pin stat image.

Omar: Uploaded clips and images to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench_apr/assets.zip.

Tess: Copy drafts posted here. Minor edit: change "62%" phrasing to "~62%" to match methodology note.

Kai: Prod routing verified after publish: leads appear in `webinar-inbound` with correct UTMs.

Lena: Thanks team. Final checklist: Omar finalize art, Tess finalize copy, Kai validate routing in prod. Close after scheduling.

Omar: Done 0 art finalized.

Tess: Drafts finalized and pinned.

Tracking-bot: Scheduling job queued for Tue 11:00 PT.
